en.buy_resale_pct: Registro 2% prima casa (resident) / 9% other homes, on cadastral value (min EUR1,000) from private sellers; + EUR100 fixed mortgage/cadastral. From VAT-registered sellers: registro EUR200 fixed.
en.buy_new_pct: VAT from developer: 4% prima casa, 10% other homes, 22% luxury (A/1, A/8, A/9); + EUR200 each registro, mortgage and cadastral tax.
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary ~1-2.5%; agent ~3-4% (+22% VAT); legal optional ~1%.
en.yearly: IMU on second homes ~0.86-1.06% of cadastral-derived value (prima casa exempt unless luxury); TARI waste tax. No imputed income tax for non-residents.
en.wealth: No general wealth tax. IVIE applies only to Italian residents owning foreign property.
en.sell: 26% substitute tax on gain if sold within 5 years of purchase; exempt after 5 years or if main home used as residence. Same for non-residents (treaty may vary).
en.rent: Non-resident: cedolare secca 21% flat (10% concordato; 26% on 2nd+ short-lets) or progressive 23/33/43% - check locally.
en.foreigners: EU free; non-EU subject to reciprocity (art.16 Civil Code), mostly satisfied; restrictions in border/military zones.

en.buy_resale_pct: Tinglysningsafgift 0.6% of price + DKK1,850; mortgage deed registration 1.5% of loan + DKK1,850.
en.buy_new_pct: No VAT on sale of new homes to private buyers; same registration duties as resale.
en.buy_fees_pct: Lawyer/advisor ~DKK10-25k (~0.5-1%); agent paid by seller; buyer's inspection/insurance extra.
en.yearly: New system from 2024: ejendomsvaerdiskat 0.51% of assessed value (1.4% above ~DKK9.2m) plus municipal grundskyld ~1.6-3.4% of land value. Same for non-residents.
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: Capital gains tax (27%/42% as capital income) but own-home exemption for owner-occupied villa/flat lived in; holiday homes taxable. Non-residents taxable in DK - check locally.
en.rent: Taxable in Denmark for non-residents (capital income, 27-42% progressive after deductions) - check locally.
en.foreigners: Non-residents (non-EU especially) need Ministry of Justice permit for any property; holiday homes only with close ties to Denmark. Residents have no restriction.

en.buy_resale_pct: Lagfart (stamp duty) 1.5% of price + SEK825 for houses; 2% pantbrev on new mortgage deeds + SEK375. None for bostadsratt (co-op) apartments.
en.buy_new_pct: VAT not charged to private buyers (included in price); same stamp duties; new builds exempt from fastighetsavgift for 15 years.
en.buy_fees_pct: Broker paid by seller; buyer's legal/inspection ~0.3-1%; co-op transfer fee small.
en.yearly: Fastighetsavgift 2026: villa 0.75% of tax value capped at SEK10,425; apartments max SEK1,784. Municipal; same for non-residents.
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: Effective 22% on the gain; deferral (uppskov) possible when buying a new home; applies to non-residents on Swedish property - check locally.
en.rent: Non-residents taxed ~30% on net rent (after SEK40k + 20% deduction for private lets) - check locally.
en.foreigners: No general restriction on homes; permit rules only for agricultural/forest land (non-EU).

en.buy_resale_pct: DMTO ~5.8% (up to ~6.3% in departments that raised the rate from April 2025); same for non-residents.
en.buy_new_pct: VAT 20% included in price; reduced registration tax ~0.7% (notary costs ~2-3%).
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary 'frais' ~7-8% resale (incl. taxes), ~2-3% new; agent ~3-6% usually seller-paid.
en.yearly: Taxe fonciere (local, varies widely); taxe d'habitation on second homes (surcharge up to +60% in tense zones). No imputed income tax.
en.wealth: IFI: 0.5-1.5% on net real estate above EUR1.3m (taxed from EUR800k); non-residents only on French real estate.
en.sell: 19% income tax + 17.2% social levies (7.5% for EU/EEA social-security affiliates); main home exempt; tapers to 0 after 22y (income) / 30y (social). Non-resident: 19% (EU/EEA) or 33.33% otherwise.
en.rent: Non-residents: 20% to ~EUR28.8k, 30% above (minimum rates) + 7.5% or 17.2% social levies - check locally.
en.foreigners: No restrictions on foreign buyers.

en.buy_resale_pct: PCC 2% of market value paid by buyer (resale, private seller). Notary taxes extra.
en.buy_new_pct: Primary market: VAT 8% (flats up to 150 sqm / houses up to 300 sqm), 23% above; no PCC on VAT sales.
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary ~0.5-1% (statutory cap, +23% VAT); land registry ~PLN200-300; agent ~2-3%.
en.yearly: Local property tax by area (residential max ~PLN1.2/sqm per year, set by municipality); no imputed income tax.
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: 19% on gain if sold within 5 years (counted from end of year of purchase); exempt after 5 years or if proceeds reinvested in own housing within 3 years. Non-residents same.
en.rent: Non-residents taxable in Poland: 8.5% lump sum to PLN100k, 12.5% above - treaty may vary.
en.foreigners: Non-EEA need Interior Ministry permit for houses/land; flats in apartment buildings free; EEA free (except farmland).

en.buy_resale_pct: Grunderwerbsteuer by state: 3.5% (Bavaria), 5% (Baden-W.), 5.5% (Hamburg, Saxony), 6% (Berlin), 6.5% (NRW, Brandenburg, Saarland, S-H, Thuringia).
en.buy_new_pct: VAT included in builder price, but transfer tax applies on land (and often building if bought with plot).
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary + land registry ~1.5-2%; agent up to 3.57% buyer share (split since 2020).
en.yearly: Grundsteuer reformed from 2025 (state models), ~0.1-0.5% of market value; no imputed income tax.
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: Speculation tax if sold within 10 years (income tax up to 45%); exempt if owner-occupied in year of sale and the 2 prior years. Applies to non-residents.
en.rent: Non-residents taxed in Germany: progressive 14-45% on net rent; filing required.
en.foreigners: No restrictions.

en.buy_resale_pct: Transfer tax 2% if you live in it; 8% for non-occupied homes (investors, second homes); 0% for ages 18-34 buying a main home under EUR555k.
en.buy_new_pct: New build within 2 years of first use: 21% VAT (usually included) instead of transfer tax.
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary + Kadaster ~EUR1,500-3,000 + mortgage costs; total buyer costs ~4-6% for owner-occupiers.
en.yearly: OZB municipal ~0.05-0.2% of WOZ value; water board tax; owner-occupiers add eigenwoningforfait ~0.35% of WOZ to taxable income.
en.wealth: No wealth tax as such; box 3 taxes a deemed return on second homes and investments (36% of an assumed return); real-return system planned from 2028 - check.
en.sell: No capital gains tax on private homes.
en.rent: Rental homes are taxed through box 3 deemed return, not on actual rent - check locally.
en.foreigners: No restrictions or surcharges.

en.buy_resale_pct: Transfer tax 3% (3.09% with municipal levy) on higher of price or objective value. Proposal (not yet law): 15% for non-EU buyers from 1 Jan 2027.
en.buy_new_pct: 24% VAT on new builds (suspended for many permits until end-2026 - check locally); no transfer tax when VAT applies.
en.buy_fees_pct: Lawyer 1-2%, notary ~1-1.5%, land registry ~0.5%, agent 2% (+24% VAT).
en.yearly: ENFIA annual property tax ~EUR0.1-13/sqm plus supplementary tax on total property value over EUR250k (0.1-1.15%). Applies to non-residents too.
en.wealth: No wealth tax; the ENFIA supplement works as a surcharge on larger holdings.
en.sell: 15% capital gains tax on property suspended for individuals (until end-2026 - check); non-residents same treatment.
en.rent: Non-residents: 15% to EUR12k, 35% to EUR35k, 45% above.
en.foreigners: Non-EU need a permit in border zones (some islands and border areas). Golden visa: EUR800k Athens/Thessaloniki/Mykonos/Santorini, EUR400k elsewhere, EUR250k conversions/restorations.

en.buy_resale_pct: Cantonal transfer tax 0-3.3% (none in ZH, ZG, SZ, UR; Bern ~1.8%, Vaud ~2.2%, Geneva ~3%).
en.buy_new_pct: New builds from developers generally VAT-free to private buyers; cantonal transfer tax applies.
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary + land registry ~0.2-1% (cantonal); total with taxes ~1-4%.
en.yearly: Imputed rental value (Eigenmietwert) taxed as income; abolition approved in Sept 2025 vote, expected from 2028 (cantons may keep a tax on second homes). Some cantons levy property tax ~0.05-0.3%.
en.wealth: Yes: cantonal wealth tax ~0.1-1% of net assets; non-residents taxed on Swiss real estate.
en.sell: Cantonal property gains tax ~10-40%, falling with holding period; applies to non-residents; roll-over relief for main home.
en.rent: Non-residents taxed on Swiss rental income (federal + cantonal progressive) - check locally.
en.foreigners: Lex Koller: non-EU/EFTA non-residents need a permit (holiday homes by cantonal quota); EU/EFTA residents free; EU non-residents only primary residence.

en.buy_resale_pct: Municipal transfer tax 0.1-3% (typically ~2-3%, Sofia 2.6%) on higher of price or tax value.
en.buy_new_pct: VAT 20% on new builds (usually included); transfer tax not applied when VAT charged.
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary ~0.1-1.5%, registry ~0.1%; lawyer ~1%; total ~3-5%.
en.yearly: Property tax 0.01-0.45% (usually ~0.15%) of tax value + waste fee; same for non-residents.
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: 10% flat on gain; exempt if held 3+ years (individuals). Applies to non-residents - check locally.
en.rent: 10% flat on net rent (after 10% standard deduction); non-residents same.
en.foreigners: EU citizens can buy land; non-EU can own buildings/flats but not land (use a Bulgarian company).

en.buy_resale_pct: IMT 0-8% progressive (main home 0-7.5%; flat 6% above ~EUR660k, 7.5% above ~EUR1.15m); + 0.8% stamp duty. Check 2026 rules for non-resident buyers.
en.buy_new_pct: Sale of new homes is VAT-exempt; IMT still applies.
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary/registry ~EUR700-1,500 (~0.5-1%); lawyer ~1%; agent seller-paid.
en.yearly: IMI 0.3-0.45% (urban, municipal) of tax value; AIMI 0.7% over EUR600k per person (1% over EUR1m, 1.5% over EUR2m).
en.wealth: AIMI works as a property wealth tax (see above); no general wealth tax.
en.sell: Residents: 50% of gain at progressive rates; main-home relief if reinvested within 36 months. Non-residents: 28% flat (or progressive for EU/EEA residents).
en.rent: Non-residents: 25% flat; lower rates for qualifying moderate rents (2026 measures).
en.foreigners: No restrictions; golden visa property route closed since Oct 2023.

en.buy_resale_pct: Transfer fees 3% to EUR85k, 5% to EUR170k, 8% above; 50% reduction in many cases - check; stamp duty 0.15%/0.2%.
en.buy_new_pct: VAT 19% (5% reduced on first 130 sqm of a main home for eligible buyers); no transfer fees when VAT paid.
en.buy_fees_pct: Lawyer ~1-1.5% +VAT; land registry/stamp ~0.3-0.5%; agent 3-5% seller-paid.
en.yearly: Immovable property tax abolished; only small municipal charges.
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: 20% capital gains tax on gain (with indexation); lifetime exemptions EUR85,430 own home, EUR17,086 any property; applies to non-residents.
en.rent: Non-residents taxed on Cyprus rent (progressive after allowances) - check 2026 reform.
en.foreigners: Non-EU need Council of Ministers permit (usually granted, one home per family); EU free.

en.buy_resale_pct: England/NI SDLT: 0% to GBP125k, 2% to 250k, 5% to 925k, 10% to 1.5m, 12% above; +5% on additional homes; +2% non-resident surcharge.
en.buy_new_pct: New homes zero-rated for VAT; same SDLT. Scotland (LBTT) and Wales (LTT) differ.
en.buy_fees_pct: Legal ~0.5-1% (GBP1.5-3k) + survey; agent seller-paid.
en.yearly: Council tax by band (local). High-value surcharge planned from 2028 on homes over GBP2m.
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: CGT 18%/24% on residential gains; main-home relief; applies to non-residents; report within 60 days.
en.rent: Non-resident landlords: income tax 20/40/45% on net profit via the NRL scheme.
en.foreigners: No restrictions; overseas entities must register.

en.buy_resale_pct: Dokumentavgift 2.5% of price on freehold homes; 0% on co-op (borettslag) shares.
en.buy_new_pct: VAT included in builder price; 2.5% dokumentavgift still applies on freehold.
en.buy_fees_pct: Registry fees ~NOK585 + mortgage; lawyer/inspection ~0.3-1%; agent seller-paid.
en.yearly: Municipal eiendomsskatt (optional) ~0.1-0.7% of assessed value.
en.wealth: Yes: formuesskatt ~1.0% above ~NOK1.76m net assets (1.1% above ~NOK20m); main home valued ~25% of market, second homes ~100%; non-residents only on Norwegian property.
en.sell: 22% on gains; exempt for main home if owned 1+ year and lived in 12 of last 24 months.
en.rent: 22% on net rental income - check locally.
en.foreigners: No permit for ordinary homes; concession law and residency duty apply to some rural/agricultural properties.

en.buy_resale_pct: ITP (regional transfer tax) 4-13% by region; typical 6-10% (Madrid 6%, Andalucia 7%, Valencia 9%, Catalonia 10-13%), charged on the higher of price or cadastral reference value.
en.buy_new_pct: VAT 10% + AJD stamp duty 0.5-1.5% by region. Canary Islands: IGIC 7% instead of VAT. ~11-12% total.
en.buy_fees_pct: Notary ~EUR600-1,200 + registry ~EUR400-700 + lawyer ~1% (+VAT): roughly 1.5-2.5% on top of tax.
en.yearly: IBI municipal tax ~0.4-1.1% of cadastral value (usually well below market). Non-residents with no rental: 19% (EU/EEA) or 24% (others) on 1.1-2% of cadastral value (Modelo 210).
en.wealth: Wealth tax: EUR700k exempt per person + EUR300k main home (residents). Solidarity tax 1.7-3.5% above EUR3M. Several regions give 100% relief (Madrid, Andalucia). Depends on region.
en.sell: Residents: 19-28% on the gain. Non-residents: 19% EU/EEA, 24% others; buyer withholds 3% of the price. Plus plusvalia municipal (local tax on land value gain).
en.rent: Non-residents: EU/EEA 19% on net income (expenses deductible); non-EU 24% on gross income. Filed via Modelo 210.
en.foreigners: NIE needed to buy; no ban on foreigners. The proposed 100% tax on non-EU non-resident buyers (Jan 2025) has not been passed as of Oct 2026.

en.buy_resale_pct: No federal transfer tax. State/county transfer + recording taxes ~0.1-2% typical (up to ~4% in Philadelphia/NYC).
en.buy_new_pct: No VAT or sales tax on homes.
en.buy_fees_pct: Closing costs ~2-5% (title insurance, lender, escrow/attorney, recording); buyer-agent fee negotiated.
en.yearly: State/local property tax; US average effective rate ~0.9% of value; range ~0.3% (HI, AL) to 2%+ (NJ, IL).
en.wealth: No wealth tax. Non-resident aliens: federal estate tax with only $60k exemption on US assets (treaties may help).
en.sell: Residents: $250k/$500k main-home gain exclusion (2 of 5 years lived in); long-term gains 0/15/20%. Foreign sellers: FIRPTA withholding 15% of price (10% for homes $300k-$1m bought to live in; 0% up to $300k).
en.rent: Non-residents: 30% on gross rent, or elect to be taxed on net rental income at normal rates.
en.foreigners: No general restriction; some states limit buyers linked to certain foreign governments.

en.Maryland: Transfer + recordation ~1.5-2.5% total (first-time buyer relief). Property tax ~0.97%.
en.New York: State transfer 0.4% (seller); mansion tax 1-3.9% above $1M. Property tax ~1.55% (upstate often 2%+).
en.Pennsylvania: Realty transfer tax ~2% (1% state + ~1% local, often split). Property tax ~1.3%.

en.buy_resale_pct: Acquisition tax 3% (reduced base for homes) + registration tax ~0.3-2% + stamp duty.
en.buy_new_pct: 10% consumption tax on the building only (land exempt); reduced acquisition/registration tax for qualifying new homes.
en.buy_fees_pct: Agent fee max 3% + JPY60k + tax; scrivener ~0.2-0.5%. Total ~6-9% resale, ~3-6% new.
en.yearly: Fixed asset tax 1.4% + city planning tax up to 0.3% of assessed value (assessed ~60-70% of market); reductions for homes.
en.wealth: No wealth tax. Inheritance tax applies to Japanese property whatever the owner's nationality.
en.sell: Non-resident: 10.21% withholding on price; gains taxed ~30% (held 5 years or less) or ~15% (more than 5). Residents ~39%/20%; JPY30m main-home exclusion.
en.rent: Non-resident: 20.42% withholding on gross rent; must file a return and appoint a tax agent.
en.foreigners: No restrictions on foreign ownership. Non-residents file a FEFTA report within 20 days.

en.buy_resale_pct: ISAI acquisition tax 2-5% by state (Quintana Roo ~3%, CDMX ~3.5-4.5%, Jalisco ~3%).
en.buy_new_pct: Residential sales generally VAT-exempt; ISAI still applies.
en.buy_fees_pct: Total closing ~5-8% (ISAI, notary ~1-1.5%, registry, appraisal; coastal trust setup USD1.5-2.5k + USD500-900/yr).
en.yearly: Predial ~0.1-0.15% of cadastral value (often far below market).
en.wealth: No wealth tax.
en.sell: Non-resident: 25% of gross price or 35% of net gain with documentation. Residents: main-home exemption with notary; otherwise up to 35%.
en.rent: Non-resident: 25% withholding on gross rent (or file via a Mexican representative). Short-term rentals add 16% VAT + lodging tax.
en.foreigners: Free inland; within 50 km of the coast or 100 km of borders you must use a bank trust (fideicomiso) or Mexican company.

en.buy_resale_pct: Provincial land transfer tax: Ontario 0.5-2.5% (+ Toronto same again); BC 1-3%; Alberta none; Quebec 0.5-3%.
en.buy_new_pct: 5% GST on new homes (13-15% HST in some provinces); rebates for cheaper and first homes.
en.buy_fees_pct: Legal/title ~0.3-0.8%; total ~1.5-4% + land transfer tax. Foreign buyer taxes: Ontario 25%, BC 20%, Nova Scotia 10%.
en.yearly: Municipal property tax ~0.3-1.2% of assessed value. BC speculation tax for foreign owners.
en.wealth: No wealth tax. Vacancy taxes in Vancouver and Toronto.
en.sell: Principal residence exemption for residents. Non-residents: 25% withholding on the gain (more without a clearance certificate).
en.rent: Non-residents: 25% withholding on gross rent, or file to pay on net income.
en.foreigners: Federal ban on non-Canadians buying homes runs until 1 Jan 2027 (exemptions for work/study permit holders, PRs, recreational homes outside big cities).

en.buy_resale_pct: Transfer tax 3% of the higher of price or official value, paid by buyer.
en.buy_new_pct: Transfer tax 3%; some new projects with CONFOTUR tourism incentives are exempt.
en.buy_fees_pct: Buyer total ~4.25-5% (3% tax, ~1% legal, notary).
en.yearly: IPI 1% on total real estate value above ~DOP10.7M (2026 threshold); nothing below it.
en.wealth: No general wealth tax; IPI works as one on real estate above the threshold.
en.sell: Capital gains ~27% of the taxable gain - check 2026 reform.
en.rent: Non-resident: 27% withholding on rent paid abroad. Short-term rentals add 18% ITBIS.
en.foreigners: No restrictions; same rights as locals.
